build_command: cd /projects/sandbox/Cal_Spread && npx tsc -b && npx vite build
verification_instructions: Run tsc -b to verify no type errors, then vite build to confirm bundle compiles
environment_constraints: Full internet access. No test suite exists - verification is via TypeScript compilation and Vite build.
contribution_requirements: No CONTRIBUTING.md present. Follow existing code patterns.
key_patterns: Components are single-file TSX in src/. No routing library - uses manual window.history + state. Props interfaces defined inline. api.ts exports all types and fetch functions. LineChart is a custom SVG chart component. StockDetail receives data via props from App.tsx.
directory_structure: src/ contains all source: App.tsx (root), StockDetail.tsx (detail page), api.ts (API layer + types), LineChart.tsx (2D chart), TradesPanel.tsx (trades modal), StockCard.tsx, format.ts. No subdirectories.
